question: What do we have to check on UAV-A17 before a training flight?
expectedAnswerPoints: Names the three checks the manual lists: compass calibration current, battery pack identifiers recorded, and the notices covering the site still in date. Cites section and page and names the source version it read.
forbiddenClaims: Must not say passing these checks makes the flight legal, authorised or compliant; no provider or model name; no document from another tenant.
